coder/code-server.what: Added a Windows release build: package job, launcher, named-pipe session socket and fixes to the Windows build scripts.
coder/code-server.why: Windows had no code-server build, and tode needed one.

nedpals/supabase-go.what: `VerifyOtp` sent its credentials in the wrong JSON shape; they are now marshalled properly.
nedpals/supabase-go.why: It broke OTP login in my own Supabase-auth project.
